method.referenceChecks: EBU Tech 3341 (V4, 2023) Table 1 cases 1-6, 9, 10, 12, 13 and true-peak cases 15-19, synthesized at 48 kHz
method.loudness: ITU-R BS.1770-5: K-weighting (Tables 1 and 2), channel weights (Table 3), 400 ms blocks with 75 % overlap, gates at -70 LKFS and -10 LU (equations 1-7)
method.windows: EBU Tech 3341: momentary 0.4 s and short-term 3 s sliding rectangular windows, ungated; highest values over every sample position
method.truePeak: ITU-R BS.1770-5 Annex 2: 4x over-sampling with the order-48, 4-phase interpolating filter, in floating point
method.normalisation: EBU R 128 (V5, 2023): target -23.0 LUFS, +/-0.5 LU for programmes that are not live, maximum true peak -1 dBTP
